discountedBill dispatch through Customer.

NOTE.Documentation:
OUTCOME with remaining replay commands unchanged:
SERVE at turn 5: C2 finishes eating turn 6, pays turn 7, satisfaction 100; final average 84.
WAIT at turn 5, serve turn 6: C2 finishes eating turn 7, pays turn 8, satisfaction 95; final average 83.
Both: 18 turns, 6 served, 5 paid, revenue $86.10, VICTORY. C2 bill remains $10.80 after promotion expires.
Customer.pay returns an immutable Receipt; Cashier returns Receipt to GameEngine, or null when no payment is eligible.
Each Cashier call collects at most one customer. Routine getters and unrelated customer work are omitted.
